data.title: MediaTek Cranks Up Pressure on Qualcomm With Cutting-Edge Smartphone Chip
data.description: Qualcomm stock dips premarket as rival MediaTek launches new 2-nanometer processors and expands into custom AI data-center chips.

data.title: EXCLUSIVE: ZenaTech Expands DaaS Footprint With Merritt Paul Acquisition
data.description: ZenaTech completed its 29th Drone as a Service acquisition, adding Merritt Paul’s expertise across utility-scale solar, transportation and construction.

data.title: Peter Schiff Calls Treasury Buybacks 'a Sign of Desperation' as Bond Yields Hit Multi-Decade Highs: 'The Markets Will Prevail in the End'
data.description: Peter Schiff says Treasury yields will keep climbing no matter what the Fed decides Wednesday, in a selloff no small hike can reverse.

data.title: Top Wall Street Forecasters Revamp AutoZone Expectations Ahead Of Q4 Earnings
data.description: AutoZone reports Q4 earnings Tuesday; analysts expect EPS to rise to $54.26 and revenue to $6.72B. Analysts remain bullish despite lower targets.

data.title: JD Vance to Ban Nearly 870,000 Suspected Offenders From Federal Loans, Citing Potential $39 Billion in COVID-Era Fraud: 'You're Cut Off'
data.description: JD Vance moves to bar 870,000 suspected fraudsters from SBA loans over $39 billion in alleged COVID-era fraud.
